method: Sequential unauthenticated HTTPS GETs; identity transfer encoding; one-MiB streaming hash chunks; exact expected byte/hash bounds; redirects restricted to the same public HTTPS alias. No cookies, authorization or protection bypass headers; no deployment, build, environment, API job or simulation action.

source_input_inventory.hash_definition: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON for the frozen relative source-file path to SHA-256 map.

readiness_check.scope: Authenticated read-only readiness metadata; all public-content checks use anonymous HTTPS without auth or bypass.

deployment_source_provenance: The launcher supplied the deployment source commit; exact deployment ID/URL/READY were independently inspected, and the full served output is independently bound to the frozen source snapshot.

scientific_proof_reuse.scope: All original public scientific files and all nine recomputation helpers are unchanged, so the prior completed public recomputation remains applicable. No large Study decode, refit, traffic rollout or repeated experiment was performed here.

media_delivery.method: Unauthenticated identity-encoded requests with redirects rejected; exact raw prefix/suffix bytes compared to the pinned frozen MP4. No playback, rendering, encoding or capture.

Browser interaction and fresh foreground-reveal-ON performance have separate records.
